findings.detail: Lead #18292. Russo was SSA CIO February through late March 2025, then became special advisor focused on technology modernization. His prior Starlink payment processor role creates direct conflict with oversight of DOGE operations that included Starlink installation at GSA headquarters. Source: CSO Online report on Borges whistleblower disclosure.

findings.summary: Michael Russo career history: California State University Long Beach (BSChe Chemical Engineering). Co-founded healthcare software company 1994 (sold 2000). CTO at Artromick International, then CTO/SVP at Prematics Inc. CTO for 7+ years at MICROS Systems (hospitality/retail tech), continuing after Oracle acquisition as Oracle Hospitality. Chief Technology Officer at Shift4 Payments 2018-2025 (part-time senior technical advisor by end). Frank Bisignano (known Russo for 20 years from industry) personally appointed him SSA CIO Jan 30 2025.

Conflict of interest: Shift4 Payments (Russo's prior employer for 6+ years) processes payment for Musk's Starlink satellite internet. Shift4 CEO Jared Isaacman nominated as NASA administrator. Russo was appointed SSA CIO by Frank Bisignano (Fiserv CEO, Trump's SSA commissioner nominee) who knew him 20 years. At SSA, Russo was 'evasive' about DOGE access, pushed for DOGE partner to have access to 'everything including source code,' and appeared to report directly to DOGE rather than SSA acting commissioner. Named defendant in federal lawsuit.

NUMIDENT authorization: On June 25 2025, CIO officials obtained from Michael Russo authorization for John Solly to upload NUMIDENT production data to DOGE test cloud environment that lacked independent security controls and bypassed security protocols. NUMIDENT contains all SSA card application data: names, DOB, citizenship, race/ethnicity, parents names and SSNs — 300+ million Americans.
